file_id: Gaggal Airport Expansion vs . Principal Secretary on 7 December, 2023

sentences.text:
Gaggal Airport Expansion vs . Principal Secretary on 7
December, 2023
Bench: Mamidanna Satya Ratna Sri Ramachandra Rao, Jyotsna Rewal Dua
Gaggal Airport Expansion Vs. Principal Secretary (Tourism & Ca) & Ors.
.
Cwp No.7846 of 2023 07.12.2023

Present: Ms. Ritta Goswami, Senior Advocate with Ms. Komal
Chaudhary, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Anup Rattan, Advocate General with Mr. Rakesh Dhaulta & Mr. Pranay Pratap Singh,
Additional Advocates General and Mr. Sidharth Jalta, Deputy of Advocate General, for respondents
no.1 to 4.
Mr. Balram Sharma, Dsgi, for respondent no.5.

Ms. Shreya Chauhan, Advocate, for
respondent no.6. rt
Due to paucity of time, the matter could not be taken up today.

Learned Advocate General assures that till the next date of hearing, the respondents will not dispossess anybody from the land, which is forming part of notification issued under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, notified for expansion of Gaggal (Kangra) Airport, and that no structure located within the land, which is subject matter of the said notification, will be demolished.

sentences.text: The said undertaking of the State is placed on record.

 (M.S. Ramachandra Rao)
 Chief Justice  (Jyotsna Rewal Dua)
